description: This file defines an immutable class 'ShutdownNoReason' implementing the 'ShutdownReason' interface, representing a placeholder for shutdown reasons with no specific reason provided.

classes.name: ShutdownNoReason
classes.description: Immutable class acting as a singleton placeholder representing the absence of a specific shutdown reason, implementing methods to return a default JSON object and type.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of shutdown reason, here a fixed 'Unknown' type.

methods.name: isRelevantFor
methods.description: Determines if the given object is relevant for this shutdown reason; always returns false.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the shutdown reason to a JSON object with no fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the shutdown reason to a JSON object considering schema version and predicate filtering; always returns an empty JSON object.
